body.estimand_functional: \(\tau_n(z_0)=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{\mathbb E_P[\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0,E_0]-m_s(z_{0s})\}\), estimated by the raw \(\widehat\tau\). Exact full-data conditional coverage and the four-channel risk and honest-length lower benchmarks hold on \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\). Under the frozen marginal-density and geometric beta-mixing conditions, \(R_\star\) is not a uniform upper frontier: a legal rare-state design forces an additional logarithmic spacing loss.

sampling_model.design: Conditional on the event state \(E_0\), each cohort has \(T\) exactly observed pre-event proxy paths with one-time densities bounded above and away from zero and a geometrically beta-mixing calendar process. These conditions permit rare local-state clustering; sequential conditional-density overlap is proposed separately and is not treated as a consequence of mixing.
sampling_model.units: At each historical path, cohort \(s\) supplies \(n_s\) conditionally independent bounded untreated wealth blocks. On the restricted class, historical errors are explicitly centered given the complete design and event means are explicitly stable given that design; these are strong added restrictions, not consequences of ordinary cross-unit independence or contemporaneous regression centering.
sampling_model.treatment: The event occurs at \(t=0\). Consistency, limited anticipation, no spillovers, and the maintained cross-date cohort-average event-transport equality identify the untreated finite-cohort event mean from the historical path regression.
sampling_model.overlap: The realized event path lies in an interior positive-probability region and every one-time historical design density is bounded below there. This marginal overlap does not guarantee iid-quality calendar spacing under the allowed triangular beta-mixing laws.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: An independent conditional donor sample estimates only the event query and its unknown full covariance. The repaired local-polynomial selector tests normalized Gram shape. The honest interval uses the full-data raw estimator, exact bounded-unit-history and bounded-event Hoeffding radii, the exact observable Taylor allowance, and a fourth-moment full-covariance donor radius; it uses no retained-block jackknife, multiplier law, or dense-local-site condition.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The paper derives identification and asymptotic-bias conditions for financial event-study estimators and explains that buy-and-hold comparisons require volatility matching.
The Holder repeated-measurement prediction rate has sparse order \((nm)^{-2s/(2s+d)}\) and dense order \(n^{-1}\), up to the stated logarithmic qualifications.
A local-polynomial Lepski procedure adapts pointwise to local design mass and local Holder smoothness under observed random design.
Theorem 1 expands local-linear regression with a generated covariate attached to every training observation through smoothed first-stage errors.
Theorems 3.1--3.6 establish deconvolution rates when latent training coordinates have replicated classical measurement error.
Theorems 7--8 evaluate a rate-optimal local-polynomial regression estimator at a sample-split estimated strongly convex minimizer.
The dependent-data theorem uses large-block--small-block coupling for conditional approximation of synthetic-control prediction error.
Spline and wavelet series estimators attain optimal uniform rates and functional normality under beta mixing and weak moments.
Ordered moduli characterize optimal confidence procedures for linear functionals over convex regression classes in a fixed Gaussian experiment.
The many-period--many-control result gives conditions for synthetic-control factor-loading recovery under imperfect pre-treatment fit.
The proximal synthetic-control theorems identify treatment effects by using excluded control outcomes as predetermined proxies.

body.tldr: The target is the cohort-weighted finite-cohort causal buy-and-hold level-wealth effect at a realized event path. Maintained cohort-average event transport identifies it through the full historical wealth-path regression, and the raw generated-center local-polynomial estimator remains exactly the event coefficient of the weighted panel regression. On the subclass imposing two explicit strong full-design strict-exogeneity and centering restrictions, a full-data interval using exact Hoeffding radii, an observable Holder allowance, and a full-covariance donor allowance is uniformly conditionally honest. Four joint causal-panel experiments prove the treated, smoothing, spacing, and donor lower benchmarks. A new rare-state block witness shows, however, that marginal design density plus geometric beta mixing permits a log(T)/T spacing scale, so neither the R-star risk upper bound nor the R-star square-root expected-length upper bound is valid on that subclass without an additional sequential local-overlap condition.

project_justification.gap: Existing repeated-measurement, generated-regressor, and synthetic-control results do not jointly distinguish causal identification, full-design replication, generated event centers, and local-design anti-clustering. In particular, geometric beta mixing and a marginal density bound do not by themselves yield iid-quality pointwise spacing.
project_justification.niche: The panel architecture observes historical proxy paths exactly, replicates bounded wealth blocks across units, and generates only the event-date query from an independent donor universe. This makes it possible to isolate which conclusions follow from causal transport and full-design centering and which additionally require sequential local overlap.
project_justification.fill: The note supplies the identifying functional and exact FWL representation, embeds all four lower-bound channels in full-design-centered causal panels, gives an exact full-data bias-aware conditionally honest interval, and proves an explicit geometrically mixing obstruction to the advertised no-log upper frontier. It also states a primitive sequential conditional-density condition that would exclude the obstruction rather than hiding the missing premise in a selector success event.

body.related_work: Goldsmith-Pinkham and Lyu motivate the causal financial-panel and volatility-drag layers; their work does not replace the maintained event-transport restriction. Yan, Yao, and Zhou study repeated-measurement prediction, Gaiffas studies pointwise random-design smoothing, and Mammen, Rothe, and Schienle study generated coordinates attached to training observations. Delaigle, Hall, and Meister concern replicated classical measurement error and deconvolution, which is absent because historical paths are exact. Cattaneo, Feng, and Titiunik motivate conditional synthetic-control uncertainty and mixing arguments, but geometric beta mixing alone does not preclude the rare-state clustering constructed here. Armstrong and Kolesar motivate modulus-based honest-length comparisons. The present proved contribution is the joint causal-panel embedding, exact FWL identity, full-data conditional coverage construction, and explicit separation between a four-channel lower benchmark and the stronger sequential-overlap premise needed for a no-log upper frontier.
body.technical_internal_limitation: Causal identification remains conditional on cohort-average event transport. The donor lower channel remains conditional on the assumed two-sided local modulus, which excludes flat surfaces. Sharp risk and honest-length statements are explicitly restricted to the subclass with event full-design mean stability and historical full-design centering. Even on that subclass, the frozen marginal-density and geometric beta-mixing assumptions permit rare-state clustering, so the four-term R-star expression is proved only as a lower benchmark and no R-star upper rate is claimed. The proposed sequential conditional-density overlap condition is sufficient to remove this particular obstruction but has not been incorporated into the class or used to certify a new upper theorem. The mean-only nonidentification result continues to concern only the restricted mean-information map, not equivalence of full historical wealth panels.
body.honest_scope: Proved claims are: causal identification conditional on event transport; the exact raw-estimator FWL identity; four positive-affinity lower-bound embeddings inside the full-design-centered subclass; the R-star minimax and honest-length lower benchmarks; deterministic normalized-shape weight and Taylor bounds; and uniform conditional coverage of the repaired full-data interval. The original-class replication obstruction remains valid. A second explicit witness now shows that the R-star risk upper bound and R-star square-root expected-length upper bound also fail on the full-design-centered subclass under geometric beta mixing alone. Higher-smoothness donor saturation remains an algebraic consequence of kappa=min(lambda,1), conditional on the two-sided modulus. No claim is made for growing cohort count, growing proxy-path dimension, smoothness adaptation, sharp constants, or a restored no-log upper frontier without sequential local overlap.
body.interpretation: Full-design centering repairs the shared-design replication failure but not the local-spacing failure. More donor securities reduce the generated-center term and more replicated units reduce bounded unit-history and event fluctuations; neither remedy creates new calendar locations near a realized query. Under the frozen dependence class, calendar locations may arrive in rare blocks, making the effective local-spacing scale log(T)/T in the exhibited scalar array.
